set.body: Acceptance criteria: Recording occupancy requires or records a named TemporalSupport policy for fixed and irregular data; irregular support is based on represented time rather than a global median weight; maximum-gap censoring and edge support are explicit; results report analysable time, censored time, excluded samples, and the chosen policy; summed weights equal analysable duration within a named Tolerance; fixed-rate behavior remains compatible; jitter, pauses, dropped samples, and single-sample edges have tests.
set.title: Add temporal-support occupancy and accounting reports
